Question: My parents are looking groom for me but we r not getting any success, plz help me shall I wear stones or tell me ruhani ilaaj. Answer ID: 5449 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 948/948=H) Do not wear any stone; rather you and your parents should recite Surah Insheraah ( سورۃ الم نشرح ) and Surah Quraish ( سورۃ قریش ) eleven times after every obligatory salah with durood 11 times before and after. And, repeat the same action with wuzu while going to bed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
